title: Menu Bar
drDigitalIntro:
The menu bar is the thin strip at the very top of your screen.
• It always shows the time on the right side, plus icons for WiFi and battery.
• On the left it shows the name of the app you are currently using.
• Click any item in the menu bar to see its options.
• The choices change depending on which app is open.
• Now look at your own screen. On a Mac this strip runs along the very top; on Windows the same information — the clock, WiFi and battery — sits in the taskbar at the bottom-right. Find yours before you continue.
drDigitalSuccess: That is the menu bar. It stays at the top, and what it offers changes with whichever app you are in.
drDigitalHint: Glance at the very top of your screen, then click Continue whenever you're ready.
